text:
talia: FYI I pushed a quick dual-package canary and a partner reported weirdness: their Vercel Edge import errors with Buffer missing, but their server app (require()) hits repeated auth retries. Also TypeScript reports mismatched export shapes. Putting notes here before I open PRs.

ravi: can you paste the exact exports block you published?

talia: sure — current minimal exports: 
```json
{
  "exports": {
    ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js" }
  },
  "main": "dist/cjs/index.js",
  "module": "dist/esm/index.js",
  "types": "dist/esm/index.d.ts"
}
```

joel: two separate things likely: (A) ESM edge runtimes don't have Buffer or Node crypto at module init; (B) CJS consumers might be getting a different fetch impl which causes cross-realm instanceof to misfire and our retry gate to loop. TS picking the wrong d.ts means we emitted per-target declarations.

ravi: for (A) we should ship an explicit edge entrypoint so platforms can prefer that code path: e.g. add an "edge" condition in exports pointing to ./dist/edge/index.mjs. That build must be pure ESM and avoid Node globals.

joel: agreed. For (B) ditch instanceof in retry logic. Use a small isResponse duck-typing util: check resp && typeof resp.status === 'number' && typeof resp.json === 'function' instead of instanceof Response. Add a unit that simulates node-fetch Response to validate.

talia: re types — I'm leaning to one canonical top-level dist/index.d.ts that re-exports platform types instead of emitting separate entry d.ts files. Also add a declarationMap? Thoughts?

ravi: declarationMap helps sourcemaps for d.ts but not resolution. Keep one index.d.ts and in package.json set "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" and inside exports set "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" as well. That reduces tsserver confusion.

joel: also consider a tiny CJS wrapper to guard interop so older consumers using require() get the expected shape:
```js
// dist/cjs/index.js
const e = require('../esm/index.js');
module.exports = e && e.__esModule ? e.default : e;
```
That prevents module.exports.default surprises without duplicating runtime code.

talia: good. One more gotcha: our ESM entry used top-level await in the canary and a couple of bundlers failed. We'll move any async init behind createClient().

ravi: CI action — add minimal smoke jobs: node-require, node-import, vite dev, bun import, cloudflare worker runner, and a TS tsserver check using a strict ESM tsconfig. Keep the scripts tiny so they run fast.

build-bot: published canary 0.14.0-canary-edge with dist/edge and dist/esm artifacts queued for smoke-suite.

joel: action items I'll take: change retry instanceof -> duck-typing + add cross-realm test; add cjs shim and small interop test.

ravi: I'll own edge build: produce dist/edge (mjs), ensure web-crypto usage (globalThis.crypto), no Buffer at top-level, and add README snippet about polyfills for older runtimes.

talia: I'll create unified index.d.ts and update package.json exports/types. Also add a short migration note in changelog about importing "pkg/edge" if bundlers ignore the condition.

joel: small doc note: mention bun edge quirks (process.* exists sometimes) and recommend feature-detection over process.version checks.

talia: thanks all — I'll link PRs here when they're ready. :sparkles:
